instruction: Work from an incomplete legacy FEniCS/DOLFIN template `/home/user/Desktop/neumann_base.py`. Complete the following: 1. Modify and generate `/home/user/Desktop/neumann.py`: - Use `MeshFunction` to mark boundaries: left boundary (`x=0`) as Dirichlet `u=0`, right boundary (`x=1`) as Neumann `g=4`; the top and bottom boundaries retain the natural zero-flux condition - Include the Neumann term in the variational form: `inner(g, v)*ds(1)` - Solve and extract the value at point `(1.0, 0.5)` - Extract the global maximum value 2. Run: `cd /home/user/Desktop && /home/user/miniconda3/bin/conda run --no-capture-output --prefix /home/user/miniconda3/envs/fenics-legacy python neumann.py` 3. Save results to `/home/user/Desktop/summary.txt` in this format: `point_value, max_value` [Software] Run the script with the legacy `dolfin` API used by `neumann_base.py` (for example, FEniCS/DOLFIN 2019.1.0), not DOLFINx.
